title: Families protest as police seal wedding venues in Sainik Farms after Delhi HC order

ai.summary: Families protested after Delhi Police sealed wedding venues in Sainik Farms following a Delhi High Court order against illegal banquet halls without fire safety clearance or permissions.

facts.claim: Delhi Police sealed wedding venues in Sainik Farms
facts.quote: Families protested against the sealing drive in Delhi’s Sainik Farms wedding venues on Monday and Tuesday after the Delhi Police acted on the orders of the Delhi high court directing civic authorities to act against banquet halls operating without valid permissions

facts.claim: Delhi High Court ordered action against illegal banquet halls
facts.quote: On November 19, the high court gave the directions after a petition by a local organisation complaining of illegal marriage venues and banquet halls, those without any fire safety clearance or statutory permissions from the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD)

facts.claim: Venues were sealed without prior notice
facts.quote: On Monday and Tuesday, as the Delhi Police started sealing the banquet halls without any prior notice, many families who had pre-booked these venues were left in disarray

facts.claim: Police sealed seven venues by Tuesday afternoon
facts.quote: Senior police officials said they sealed seven venues by Tuesday afternoon

ai.background_note: Delhi High Court directed sealing of illegal wedding venues in Sainik Farms after petition by local organisation over fire safety and permissions.
